why: The tester's own last text already said sleeping better would be huge.

transcript.text:
Hey, I'm ZOH, your texting coach! I'll help you get better at one thing with one small step a day. Text "stop" anytime, and you can change how I coach whenever you want, just say "chill out" or "push me harder."

What's your name, and what are you looking to work on?

• Put AI to work for you
• Read & learn more (books, ideas, any topic)
• Start something on the side
• Focus & get more done
• Speak & connect better
• Get fitter
• Eat better
• Sleep better
• Learn a fun skill (Rubik's cube, card trick, play a song, drawing)
• Not sure? Let's figure it out together
That's fine, Jordan, we'll figure it out together. What do you do for work, or what fills most of your days?
I'm a nurse, I work night shifts
Night shifts, respect. What do you do to unwind or have fun when you're off the clock?
cards and poker with the crew on breaks, and I used to read a lot before nights
Cards on breaks, and you used to read a lot before nights, I like that. What pulled you away from reading once the night shifts started?
honestly nights just wiped me out. by the time i'm off i'm too tired to focus on a book. sleeping better would be huge tbh
Sleep it is, Jordan, and for a night nurse that's a big one. When you get home after a shift, what usually happens between walking in the door and falling asleep?
